fact: CEPICI's director general says that by mid-July 2026 online company creation averaged 2.4 days, with the CEPICI platforms interoperable with the Tribunal de Commerce, the DGI and the CNPS, and that more than 4,200 RCCM were recovered and sent online.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : le délai de création d'entreprise en ligne ramené à 2,4 jours, annonce la DG du CEPICI
